integrity: The proof derives the second iterate exactly from the rank-one update, applies only Rayleigh and Stieltjes sign bounds for sufficiency, and gives a two-dimensional diagonal obstruction for every gamma below the spectral width. Exact-rational replay independently reconstructs the update and witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The sharp threshold is uniform over symmetric positive definite Stieltjes matrices with spectrum in [mu,L] and concerns the second good-Broyden iterate from B0=gamma I. Later iterates, nonsymmetric M-matrices, and non-scalar initial Jacobian approximations are not classified.
title: Spectral width is the sharp second-iterate positivity threshold for good Broyden
